key.name: open-shortcut
key.description: Extra keyboard shortcuts that open Visor. The shortcut of the shell for the notification list (Super+V by default) always opens it.

key.name: hover-preview
key.description: Peek at the island content when the pointer rests on it.

key.name: peek-delay
key.description: Time in milliseconds the pointer must rest on the island before it peeks.

key.name: flash-on-events
key.description: Briefly expand the island when a module reports an event.

key.name: width
key.description: Width preset of the expanded island.

key.name: disabled-modules
key.description: Identifiers of modules that are turned off.

key.name: module-order
key.description: Identifiers of modules in the order they are shown.

key.name: currency-rates
key.description: Fetch exchange rates online for the unit and currency converter.

key.name: upcoming-calendar
key.description: Show the current week above the next events. Its title opens the month; a day shows its events.

key.name: catalog-updates
key.description: Let the settings window fetch the current catalog of modules and its pictures when the Modules page is opened, at most once a day. Off: the catalog that came with this version is shown, without pictures that are not cached.

key.name: catalog-url
key.description: Where catalog.json and the pictures below modules/ are fetched from. Must be https, or http for this machine.

key.name: debug-metrics
key.description: Log performance metrics of the extension to the journal.
